_comment: Claim-extraction judges. Both go through Ramp's Router (router.com) with one Router key (ROUTER_API_KEY, falling back to JEV_API_KEY if unset). Called from the harness host only, never from a VM. Router keeps model inputs/outputs for 1 year by default (opt-out available).

jev._baseUrl: The Jev SDK appends /v1/systemone. User-tested 2026-10-14: GET /v1/models lists jev-1.13.0; empty POST /v1/systemone and /v1/decisions → 400 (auth accepted).

llmJudge._model: Switched 2026-10-14 from claude-sonnet-5-5 (now an agent model) to gpt-6-sol, a different family from both agent models. Verified 200 by the user's peer session; the response carries a cost field.
